field_about_portal:
About the portal

The Association to Function Knowledge Portal aggregates and integrates genetic association, functional genomic, and computational results to accelerate research on complex diseases. Get an overview in this brief video, or download a quick reference guide.

About the project

The Association to Function Knowledge Portal is being developed by a team of scientists and software engineers at the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard and collaborating researchers across the globe, with support from the National Human Genome Research Institute. We welcome the involvement of interested researchers. If you would like to contribute data or collaborate on analyses, methods, or tool development, please contact us.
